question_ru: Насос P-215 вибрирует 4,0 мм/с. Это норма?
question_en: Pump P-215 vibrates at 4.0 mm/s. Is that normal?
note: registry: station 2, no power, no class, no datasheet; not in Table A.1. Class I: above 2,8, inspect within 24 h; class II: normal

question_ru: Насос P-220 вибрирует 5,0 мм/с. Его нужно останавливать?
question_en: Pump P-220 vibrates at 5.0 mm/s. Must it be stopped?
note: no P-220 in the registry: P-220A (11 kW, class I) and P-220B (37 kW, class II). A: above 4,5, stop; B: inspect within 24 h

question_ru: На насосной станции № 2 насос вибрирует 4,0 мм/с. Нужно ли его осматривать?
question_en: A pump at pump station No. 2 vibrates at 4.0 mm/s. Must it be inspected?
note: no tag: station 2 has class I and class II pumps. Class I: inspect; class II: normal

question_ru: Насос P-216 после установки вибрирует 4,0 мм/с. Нужно ли его осматривать?
question_en: Pump P-216 vibrates at 4.0 mm/s after installation. Must it be inspected?
note: spare pump, class II, station not assigned: R-12 (station 2) 4,5, normal; R-14 (station 3) 3,5, inspect. Not a conflict: only one of the two applies, and the registry does not say which

question_ru: Какой смазкой смазывать подшипники насоса P-215?
question_en: Which grease must be used for the bearings of pump P-215?
note: R-12 7.1: the grease named in the datasheet; P-215 has no datasheet in the archive

question_ru: Насос P-101: в вертикальном направлении 4,2 мм/с, горизонтальное и осевое направления не измеряли. Вибрация в норме?
question_en: Pump P-101: 4.2 mm/s in the vertical direction; the horizontal and axial directions were not measured. Is the vibration normal?
note: R-12 4.3.1: the result is the largest of three directions; two are missing, so 4,2 < 4,5 proves nothing. Needs a person: measure again. The status is arguable (a careful 'answered' that asks to re-measure is also safe); graded by status
